correctness.rationale: For four generator states (00,10,01,11), solve stationary balance: w=2bv/(2e+d), u=[e+d+bd/(2e+d)]v/a. Normalization yields positive stationary probabilities, and Cov(X1,X2)=uw-v²=F(d)/[a(2e+d)^2 Z^2], with the denominator positive. For fixed d the quadratic in b is strictly increasing on b>0. The critical b(d) has exactly one interior minimum iff a>2e (from F=F_d=0 and the discriminant), with tangency b*=2sqrt[e(a+2e)]-3e; the endpoints b(0)=a and b(infinity)=a/2 classify 0,1,2 crossings. At (a,b,e)=(10,4,1), F=-2(d-2)(d-6); independent symbolic substitution gives exact covariance -60/3721 at d=0, 20/15129 at d=4 and -60/40401 at d=8. The source standard-library verifier builds and solves the actual four-state generator in rational arithmetic; finite checks corroborate, while the algebra proves all positive real parameters.
